subject: Wrong Game
text: A commenter suggests dragging the icon into image search as a hint for Wrong Game.

evidence.quote: try dragging the icon into image search.

subject: Pump You Up
text: Pump You Up is triggered by reaching level 41.

evidence.quote: "Pump You Up" is triggered by reaching level 41.

subject: No Grinding Allowed!
text: One commenter found No Grinding Allowed! the only achievement that gave real trouble.

evidence.quote: Only one that gave me real trouble was "No Grinding Allowed!".

subject: Hardcore mode
text: Achievements unlock again if hardcore mode was enabled and the game was revisited after achieving without hardcore.

evidence.quote: That's normal if you enabled hardcore mode and came back to the game after achieving without hardcore.

subject: There's a Reason We Don't Use DOS Anymore
text: Unlocking requires the health bar set to the graphical view when reaching level 22.

evidence.quote: I just need to have the health bar set to the graphical view when I hit level 22

subject: Traditionalist
text: Traditionalist requires the health bar on the numeric view when reaching level 25.

evidence.quote: for "Traditionalist" it needs to be on the numeric view when I hit level 25

subject: health bar view
text: The health bar must be on the correct view before that level is reached.

evidence.quote: Correct just make sure you put it on the correct view before that level

subject: first fight
text: Dying in the first fight is possible though extremely rare.

evidence.quote: losing to the first fight ?...As it is possible to actually possible to die on though extremely rare

subject: game ending
text: Beating the game forces a reset at the end of the credits.

evidence.quote: I beat the game, which forces a reset at the end of the credits.

subject: final achievement
text: Overwriting the end-game save locks the final achievement unless the whole game is replayed.

evidence.quote: I instinctively saved, overwriting my end game save....I'm now locked out of the final achievement and mastering the game unless I play through the entire game again.

subject: Traditionalist
text: Traditionalist was not retroactive, so one player had to restart the game.

evidence.quote: had to restart completely after finding out Traditionalist wasn't retroactive.

subject: achievement set
text: Most of the achievement set consists of collecting items.

evidence.quote: Most of this set is getting the items.

subject: final boss
text: A commenter suggests level cap challenges and not using the Cure Bug on the final boss as possible revision challenges.

evidence.quote: Only thing I can think of is level cap challenges, and not using the Cure Bug on the final boss

subject: dungeons
text: Dungeons are very confusing and easy to get lost in without a guide.

evidence.quote: the dungeons are very confusing, you can easily get lost in them without a guide.

subject: achievements
text: Achievements cannot be earned using a save from a completed game.

evidence.quote: You can't earn cheevos using a directly save from a completed game

subject: coin achievements
text: Coin achievements are not listed on the page but pop up in-game.

evidence.quote: The coin achievements are not listed here but pop in-game.

subject: weapon collect achievements
text: Some weapon collect achievements did not unlock the first time but unlocked after loading and collecting the items a second time.

evidence.quote: Few weapon collect achievements didn't unlock first time but i got them after loading and getting them 2nd time.

subject: sequence breaking weapons or armor
text: Sequence breaking some weapons or armor can cause missable achievements.

evidence.quote: with a few missable achievements if you sequence break some weapons/armor

subject: max lvl achievement

evidence.quote: Just wish there was no grinding to max lvl achievement.
